name: Jephthah
overview: Jephthah, described as a mighty man of valor yet the son of a harlot, was rejected by his half-brothers and cast out from his father's house because of his illegitimate birth. He fled to the land of Tob, where he gathered a group of followers, but was later called back by the elders of Gilead to lead Israel in battle against the Ammonites. Despite his initial bitterness toward those who expelled him, Jephthah accepted the call to be their captain, demonstrating God's providential use of flawed individuals to accomplish His purposes.
